headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for all headings above 32px. Never use generic fonts like Inter or Roboto for headings.

body.usage: Loose line height (leading-relaxed) for readability. Crisp and professional.

labels.usage: Uppercase, tiny text with wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]) for overlines and tags.

rules.gradients: Do not use generic gradients. Use solid colors or very subtle mesh gradients if needed. Never use a gradient as a text background.
rules.contrast: Always ensure text meets APCA standards. When using primary (#1a2f6b) or accent (#3aa935) as background, use crisp white text. Do not use transparent backgrounds under text that rests over images.
rules.hover_states: ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover. Focus states must have HIGHER contrast.

surfaces.header: Crystal Glass variant: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-[#1a2f6b]/10. Never fully transparent.
surfaces.cards: Grid Borders or Flat Solid surfaces. 1px subtle border with very soft shadows (shadow-sm). On hover, slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg.
surfaces.AI_widget: Neumorphism or Glassmorphism to distinguish it as an interactive 'smart' tool.
surfaces.borders: Keep border radii crisp. Use rounded-md or rounded-none for a more structured, financial feel.

visual_enhancers.decorations: Subtle grain overlays to remove digital flatness. Use fine 1px structural lines to separate sections instead of massive background color blocks.

component_name.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular buttons. Primary action buttons should use the Vibrant Green (#3aa935) for high conversion. Secondary buttons use outline or Navy (#1a2f6b).
component_name.inputs: Shadcn UI standard inputs but customized: 1px border, square or slightly rounded edges, focus ring using Navy (#1a2f6b).
component_name.forms: Use Shadcn forms for reliable UX.
component_name.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) with Duotone weight to look high-end and professional.

grids.general_spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24.
grids.services_grid: MODE A: The 'Tetris' Grid. Asymmetric. Example: Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 with wide gaps (gap-8). Spans mixing col-span-4 and col-span-8 to avoid boring equal squares.
grids.technical_rules: Grid items MUST be direct children of grid containers. Avoid wrappers that break grid-cols.

layouts.hero: Asymmetric layout. Large typographic statement on the left, high-quality overlapping imagery or a curated bento cluster of images on the right.
layouts.about: Editorial style. Large headings, wide margins.
layouts.navigation: Visible desktop nav bar with Logo, links, and 'Get a Quote' CTA. Sticky with z-50.
layouts.footer: Massive Space (py-20). Dark theme for footer (bg-[#1a2f6b] with white text) to provide strong contrast from the light body.

motion.general: Smooth, professional, not bouncy. Use Framer Motion for staggered entrance animations on lists/grids.
motion.interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements. Buttons must have a transform scale or lift.
motion.scroll: Implement 'lenis' for smooth scrolling. This is MANDATORY for a premium feel.

accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on all inputs/buttons.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='contact-submit-button').

media.hero_overlay: If placing text over hero image, max overlay opacity bg-black/40. If more is needed, use a gradient overlay, not flat.
media.image_constraints: Mobile images must not exceed 80vh max height.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use Framer Motion for simple 2D interaction (like the Document Analyzer scanning effect). Complex 3D is not required unless building a highly interactive globe/map.
3d_libraries.AI_Document_Analyzer: Use Framer Motion to create a scanning line (The 'Tracing Beam' effect) over uploaded documents.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react framer-motion lenis sonner react-fast-marquee clsx tailwind-merge
Set up standard Shadcn components for forms, inputs, selects, dialogs. Do NOT build these from scratch.
Implement the landing page in pure HTML/Tailwind CSS without Shadcn structural cards to allow asymmetric E1 layouts.
The branding colors MUST be exactly Navy Blue (#1a2f6b) and Vibrant Green (#3aa935). Do not deviate.
For the AI Document Analyzer feature, create an interactive UI where users can upload a file, and display a Framer Motion 'scanning' line over the document preview while processing.
Ensure the floating WhatsApp widget and AI Chatbot widget are clearly visible but do not obstruct main content. Use the Green (#3aa935) for WhatsApp.
Do NOT center align everything. Use left alignment for readability.
Create a clean Admin panel using Shadcn tables to display captured leads.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics. Be creative and distinctive.
Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). It disrupts reading flow.
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons. Use Phosphor Icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on provided image URLs. NEVER use placeholder text/URLs.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
